info.name: Identities API - Dashboard v1
info.description:
Every endpoint the Identities dashboard front-end calls, reverse-engineered from `features/*/api.ts` + `utils/api/api-factory.ts`.

## Conventions baked into the client

- **Base URL**: `https://identities.g4t.io/api/dashboard/v1/` (`api/client.ts`).
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request except the Public folder. A 401 clears storage and redirects to /login.
- **Key casing**: axios interceptors run `decamelizeKeys` on request bodies AND query params, and `camelizeKeys` on responses. You write `organizationId` in TS but the wire format is `organization_id` - this collection shows the wire format.
  - Exception: `/identity` sets `disableRequestKeyConversion: true`, so its multipart keys go out verbatim (`template_id`, plus template variable names untouched).
  - Exception: `/member_request` sets `preserveNestedFormDataKeys: true`, so only the root key is snake_cased (`join_data[0][InputName]` keeps `InputName`).
- **Updates**: factories with `isFormData: true` (identity, organization, member_request) send POST to `/{resource}/{id}` with a `_method=PUT` field (Laravel convention). JSON factories send a real PUT.
- **Pagination**: `page` + `per_page` (from `pageSize`, default 10; UI offers 5/10/20/50). `serializeQuery()` currently DROPS sort/order (commented out in `utils/api/api.ts`), so sorting is client-side-key only today.
- **Array params** serialize as `key[]=v1&key[]=v2`, e.g. `statuses[]=4&statuses[]=5`.
- **Date-range filters** send two ISO timestamps: `created_at_range[]=<from>&created_at_range[]=<to>`.
- **List envelope**: `{ data: { data: [...], meta: { total, current_page, per_page } } }`. Single-item GET returns `{ data: {...} }`.

Optional query params are present but disabled - tick them in Postman to use them.

item.name: Auth
item.description: `features/auth/api.ts`. Phone + OTP login. If the account has TOTP enabled, login returns `temp_token` instead of `access_token` and you must call 2FA enable to exchange it.

request.description: Body `OTPInput`: `phone` only.

Body `LoginInput`. `captchaToken` is decamelized to `captcha_token`; send `null` when reCAPTCHA is off.

Returns `{ access_token | temp_token, token_type, expires_in, user }`. The test script stores whichever token came back into `{{token}}`.
Tells the login page whether to render the reCAPTCHA widget.
Call with the temp token. Returns `{ secret, qr_code }` where `qr_code` is an inline SVG string.
Body `TotpVerifyInput` = `{ otp }` (6-digit TOTP). Exchanges the temp token for the real `access_token` - this path is the `iss` seen in production JWTs.
No body.

item.name: Identities (ID cards)
item.description:
`features/ids/api.ts`, endpoint `/identity`, `isFormData: true`, `disableRequestKeyConversion: true` (multipart keys sent verbatim).

This one list endpoint backs FOUR dashboard screens - they differ only by the default `statuses[]` filter:

| Screen | statuses[] |
|---|---|
| /ids | none (all) |
| /printer | 4,5,6 (WAITING_TO_PRINT, PRINTING, PRINTED) |
| /delivery | 6,7,8,9 (PRINTED, DELIVERY_IN_PROGRESS, DELIVERED, RETURNED) |
| /ids-flow | none, uses /identity/node |

**Status enum** (`features/ids/types.ts`): 0 PENDING, 1 PAID, 2 APPROVED, 3 REJECTED, 4 WAITING_TO_PRINT, 5 PRINTING, 6 PRINTED, 7 DELIVERY_IN_PROGRESS, 8 DELIVERED, 9 RETURNED.

query.description: 1-based page number.
Page size. UI options: 5 / 10 / 20 / 50.
Repeat per status id. 4/5/6 = the printer queue.
Free-text search box above the table.
Per-column text filter (TS: memberName).
Per-column text filter (TS: memberPhone).
TS: templateTitle. Used on /ids and /ids-flow.
TS: organizationId. Admin-only filter on /ids.
From. Send both entries together.
To.

request.description: THE endpoint the /printer page uses. There is no /printer API route - `/printer` is only a Next.js page path.
`useGetIdsNode` - same filter surface as the plain list, but scoped to the nodes the caller can act on (/ids-flow board).
Returns the card plus `template`, `member`, `organization`, and `node_history[]`.

formdata.description: Template variable values. Sent as a nested object -> identity[job_title]=... in real requests.
Any File/Blob field declared by the template becomes its own multipart part.

request.description: `CreateIDCardInput` = `{ name, phone, identity, template_id }` plus arbitrary template variables. Keys are NOT converted (disableRequestKeyConversion), so send exactly the names the template declares.

formdata.description: Laravel method spoofing - the factory appends this for every FormData update.
`UpdateIdVars` is an open Record<string, unknown> - any template variable.

request.description: `useUpdateIdVars`. POST + `_method=PUT` because PHP cannot parse multipart on a real PUT.
`ChangeStatusInput` = `{ status: number, notes?: string }`. `status` is the numeric id, not the name. This is what the Send-to-printer button and the delivery screen call.
`ApprovedSIdInput` = `{ identity_id, notes, attachments: File[], fields?: {key,value}[] }`. Multipart POST with `_method=PUT`; the node-history entry is built from `fields` + `attachments`.
Note the id travels in the BODY here, not the path.
Send EITHER `issue_date` OR `expiration_date` (TS: `issueDate` / `expirationDate`, decamelized by the interceptor).

item.name: Members
item.description: `features/members/api.ts`, endpoint `/member`, JSON factory (real PUT on update).

request.description: `CreateMembersInput`. `organization_id` is only sent by admins - org users are scoped by their token.
`UploadMembersInput` = `{ file, organization_id? }`. Multipart. Note `/member_request` reuses this same endpoint for its upload button.
Binary .xlsx (client fetches with `responseType: arraybuffer` and skips key conversion). No params.

query.description: Single free-text `filter` param (not the field/value array used by list endpoints).

request.description: Client tolerates both a bare array and the `{data:{data:[]}}` envelope.

item.name: Member requests (join requests)
item.description: `features/members-requests/api.ts`, endpoint `/member_request`, `isFormData: true` + `preserveNestedFormDataKeys: true` - so `joinData[0][InputName]` goes out as `join_data[0][InputName]` (inner keys keep their PascalCase).

query.description: STRING statuses here: pending | approved | rejected (unlike identities, which use numeric ids).

request.description: Includes `join_data[]` - the filled application-form answers, each `{ InputName, InputLabel, InputType, InputRequired, Options?, InputValue }`.
`UpdateMembersInput` is `{ name }` only.
`status`: `approved` or `rejected`. One endpoint, two buttons (`useApproveMember` / `useRejectMember`).

item.name: Organizations
item.description: `features/organizations/api.ts`, endpoint `/organization`, `isFormData: true` (logo upload).

formdata.description: 0/1 as a number, not a boolean.
Turns the public join form on.

item.name: Application form (org join form)
item.description: `features/application-form/api.ts`. Note the asymmetric paths: reading is nested under the org, writing is a flat `/organization/form` resource.

request.description: Returns `{ id, body: ApplicationFormInput[], organization_id }`.

`InputType`: string | number | boolean | date | select | image | file. `Options` only applies to `select`. The inner PascalCase keys are inside an array of objects, which `decamelizeKeys` walks - confirm against the backend if it rejects snake_cased inner keys.

item.name: Branches
item.description: `features/branches/api.ts`, endpoint `/branch`, JSON factory.

query.description: Note: plain `organization`, NOT organization_id, on this table.
Parent branch filter.

request.description: Unpaginated. Used to populate the branch picker when a template has `branch_required`.
`CreateBranchInput`. `node_ids` is required (the workflow nodes this branch handles).

item.name: Users (admin)
item.description: `features/users/api.ts`, endpoint `/user`. Dashboard admins.

request.description: Careful: this one is `role_id` as an ARRAY (TS `roleId?: number[]`), unlike org/branch users which use `role_ids`.
`phone` is not updatable.
Empty body. Clears the user's TOTP secret so they re-enroll at next login.

item.name: Organization users
item.description: `features/organization-users/api.ts`, endpoint `/organization_user`.

request.description: `role_ids` (plural) here. `node_ids` limits which workflow nodes the user can act on.

item.name: Branch users
item.description: `features/branch-users/api.ts`, endpoint `/branch_user`.

request.description: `branch_id` is required.

item.name: Roles & permissions
item.description: `features/roles/api.ts` + `features/permissions/api.ts`. One `/role` endpoint serves three screens (admin-roles / organization-roles / branch-roles) via the `type` param.

query.description: REQUIRED in practice - admin | organization | branch. Always appended by the tables.

request.description: `permissions` is an array of permission IDs. Send `organization_id` for type=organization, `branch_id` for type=branch.

query.description: Role modals pull a large page to render the full permission matrix.

request.description: Read-only - the factory only exposes `useGetList`. Permission names are the strings used by `<Permission can="create-role">`.

item.name: Nodes (workflow steps)
item.description: `features/nodes/api.ts`, endpoint `/node`. Nodes are the stages an identity passes through on the /ids-flow board.

query.description: Plain `organization` on this table (not organization_id).

request.description: `color` is a hex string used for the board chip.

item.name: Templates
item.description: `features/templates/api.ts`, endpoint `/template`, JSON factory. `template` holds the Polotno/editor design JSON.

query.description: `organization` = owned by an organization (the caller's own, or every organization's for an admin); `global` = the public catalogue, owned by nobody. Drives the two tabs of the templates screen.
Admin only, and only meaningful with `type=organization`.

request.description: Returns `template` (design JSON), `front_image`, `back_image`, `share_key`, `identities_count`, `identity_duration`, `branch_required`.

`price` is a STRING. `is_enabled` is a string on create/update (`"1"`), unlike the numeric `is_enabled` on organizations. `identity_duration` is in days. `front_image`/`back_image` are data URLs rendered from the editor.
Real PUT (JSON factory). Send the FULL `template` design JSON - a partial write is what blanks out previews.
`CloneTemplateInput`. Copies the design into a new template, optionally into another organization.
Empty body. Resets the ascending card-number sequence for this template.
Queues/produces an export job; the resulting files are listed by Template exports > List exports.
Top-level `/export` (not nested under /template). Each row: `{ id, status, file, template, organization, created_at }`.

item.name: Template flow
item.description: `features/template-flow/api.ts`, endpoint `/template/flow`. Only get-by-id and create are wired in the UI (create doubles as upsert).

request.description: The id in the path is the TEMPLATE id. Returns `{ id, template_id, nodes[] }`.
`node_ids` order defines the stage order on the flow board.

item.name: Forms (form templates)
item.description: `features/form-template/api.ts`, endpoint `/form`. Standalone public form builder (separate from the org join form).

request.description: `form` is a STRING (serialized builder schema), not an object. `slug` is the public URL segment.

item.name: Customers
item.description: `features/customers/api.ts`, endpoint `/customers` (note the plural - the only plural endpoint in the API).

item.name: Blacklist
item.description: `features/black-list/api.ts`, endpoint `/blacklist`. No update hook - create and delete only.

item.name: API keys
item.description: `features/api-keys/api.ts`, endpoint `/access_key` (the UI calls them API keys).

request.description: Only `name` is sent; the server generates `key` and binds it to the caller's org/user.

item.name: Payments
item.description: `features/payments/api.ts`, endpoint `/payment`. Read-only - the factory exposes only list and get-by-id.

query.description: This table exposes updated_at_range only - no created_at_range filter.

item.name: Webhook
item.description: `features/webhooks/api.ts`. A singleton resource - no id, no list.

request.description: Returns `{ url, secret_key, secret_value, method }`.
Upsert. Body is `{ webhook_url }` (TS: `webhookUrl`) - asymmetric with the GET response, which returns the field as `url`.

item.name: Statistics
item.description: `features/statistic/api.ts`. Powers the dashboard home page.

request.description: No params. Returns `total_identities`, `total_members`, `total_member_requests`, `total_pending_member_requests`, `total_organizations`, `identities_in_year[{month,total}]`, `latest_members_requests[]`, `top_organizations[]`.

item.name: Public (no auth)
item.description: Different host: `https://api.bajat.net/api/public/v1`. Used by the public application form at `/ids-templates-forms/[id]`, where `[id]` is the template `share_key`. No Authorization header.

item.name: Get public template by share key

request.description: Returns the template design + the variable definitions the public form renders.

formdata.description: Injected by the client from the URL segment.

request.description: Multipart, `skipRequestKeyConversion: true` - keys go out exactly as typed. Creates a PENDING (status 0) identity.
